title: A meal after metamorphosis
hook: Two stages of one life cycle can feed differently.

knows: Animals have body structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The caterpillar is shown against a leaf; the adult is shown with a mouthpart at a flower. This is a simplified example: diets differ among species and life stages, and not every adult butterfly feeds in the same way.

misconception: An animal must eat the same food throughout all life stages.
objective: In this illustrative life cycle, a caterpillar eats leaves. Which resource does the adult butterfly use in the example?
